proposals.title: Node sparks
proposals.direction: Scattered embers (r008-03) retained in full: identical layout, Amber lantern palette, filled understood nodes, travel speed, passing glow and comet trail. Nodes release a restrained ring of 12 sparks when crossed by the light dot.

proposals.title: Forward embers
proposals.direction: Scattered embers (r008-03) retained in full: identical layout, Amber lantern palette, filled understood nodes, travel speed, passing glow and comet trail. Nodes release a fan of 16 embers in the light dot's direction when crossed.

proposals.title: Scattered embers
proposals.direction: Layout from r002-01; Amber lantern palette from r004-01; outward travel from r005-02; new-segment relay from r006-03; speed and passing glow from r007-01. A slightly fuller trail with gentle sideways drift and a subtle late sparkle. Particles live 610–690 ms (+500 ms). Understood nodes use solid amber with a dark checkmark, per the explicit phase exception.
